notes: «وبهذا الإسناد رفعه إلى النبي» takes the chain of prev1 (it writes its chain): the names are inherited, the common man «رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْعَوَامِّ» stays the last link before the raising.
The Imam of prev1 is not in this chain: the text raises the report to the Prophet, who is the end and not a link. The «بهذا الإسناد» back_reference is not written, since the names are inherited.
